description_en: Queries a list of control policies
description_zh: 调用ListControlPolicies查询管控策略列表
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager list-control-policies --policy-type System --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --biz-language zh-CN --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListControlPolicies

parameters.help_en:
The type of the control policy. Valid values:

System: system control policy.
Custom: custom control policy
parameters.help_zh:
管控策略类型。取值：

System：系统管控策略。
Custom：自定义管控策略
parameters.name: policy_type

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The language in which you want the description of the control policy to be returned. Valid values:

zh-CN (default): Chinese.
en: English.
ja: Japanese.

This parameter is valid only for system control policies
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回结果中管控策略描述的语言。取值：

zh-CN（默认值）：中文。
en：英文。
ja：日文。

该参数仅在系统管控策略时有效
parameters.name: language

AttachmentCount.description_en: The number of times the control policy is referenced
AttachmentCount.description_zh: 管控策略被引用的次数

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the control policy was created. The time is displayed in UTC, as specified by RFC 3339, with Z indicating UTC
CreateDate.description_zh: 管控策略创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 时间格式，以 Z 表示 UTC

Description.description_en: The description of the control policy
Description.example: 支持阿里云所有操作的系统管控策略

EffectScope.description_en:
The effective scope of the control policy. Valid values:

All: The control policy applies to Alibaba Cloud accounts, Resource Access Management (RAM) users, and RAM roles.
RAM: The control policy applies only to RAM users and RAM roles
EffectScope.description_zh:
管控策略生效范围。取值：

All：表示该管控策略针对阿里云账号、RAM用户或RAM角色生效。
RAM：表示该管控策略仅针对RAM用户或RAM角色生效

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the control policy

PolicyName.description_en: The name of the control policy

PolicyType.description_en:
The type of the control policy. Valid values:

System: system control policy.
Custom: custom control policy
PolicyType.description_zh:
管控策略类型。取值：

System：系统管控策略。
Custom：自定义管控策略

UpdateDate.description_en: The time when the control policy was last updated. The time is displayed in UTC, as specified by RFC 3339, with Z indicating UTC
UpdateDate.description_zh: 管控策略更新时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 时间格式，以 Z 表示 UTC

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页时每页显示的数据条数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of control policies
